modules.title: Introduction to The Patriarchs: Abraham
modules.html:
God's call of Abraham, the covenant, and the promise of descendants and land; Abraham's faith and obedience, including the test with Isaac. This section covers introduction to the patriarchs: abraham.

Key points

  • In the call of Abraham, God's command to 'Go from your country...' was a test of his _____. — faith.
  • The son of Abraham through Hagar was _____. — Ishmael.
  • God's promise to Abraham that he would be the father of many nations was sealed with the sign of _____. — circumcision.
  • The son of Abraham born to the Egyptian maid Hagar was _____. — Ishmael.
  • Abraham's son: — Isaac.

Worked examples

Q: In the call of Abraham, God's command to 'Go from your country...' was a test of his _____.
A: faith — Abraham's departure for an unknown land demonstrated absolute trust and faith in God's promise.

Q: The son of Abraham through Hagar was _____.
A: Ishmael — Ishmael was Abraham's first son, though Isaac was the son of the promise through Sarah.

examples.q: In the call of Abraham, God's command to 'Go from your country...' was a test of his _____.
The son of Abraham through Hagar was _____.

quiz.q: In the call of Abraham, God's command to 'Go from your country...' was a test of his _____.
quiz.solution: Abraham's departure for an unknown land demonstrated absolute trust and faith in God's promise.

quiz.q: The son of Abraham through Hagar was _____.
quiz.solution: Ishmael was Abraham's first son, though Isaac was the son of the promise through Sarah.

quiz.q: God's promise to Abraham that he would be the father of many nations was sealed with the sign of _____.
quiz.solution: In Genesis 17, God established circumcision as the physical sign of the covenant between Him and Abraham's descendants.

quiz.q: The son of Abraham born to the Egyptian maid Hagar was _____.
quiz.solution: Ishmael was Abraham's first son, born when Sarah remained childless.

quiz.q: Abraham's son:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Isaac.

quiz.q: The wife of Abraham was:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Sarah.

quiz.q: Abraham was called by God from:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Ur of the Chaldeans.

quiz.q: God tested Abraham by asking him to sacrifice:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Isaac.

quiz.q: God called Abraham out of which city?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ur of the Chaldeans.

quiz.q: Abraham's faith was tested when God asked him to...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Sacrifice his son Isaac.

quiz.q: Abram’s name was changed to Abraham, meaning?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Father of many nations.

quiz.q: The test of Abraham’s faith was the?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Sacrifice of Isaac.

quiz.q: Moses' father-in-law, who advised him on how to delegate judicial duties, was _____.
quiz.solution: Jethro, the priest of Midian, observed Moses wearing himself out and advised him to appoint capable men as leaders over thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens.

quiz.q: Jesus was born in Bethlehem during the census ordered by _____.
quiz.solution: Luke 2 records that a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be registered.

quiz.q: The parable of the Prodigal Son was primarily told to illustrate _____.
options: the love and forgiveness of God
quiz.solution: The father's reception of the lost son represents God's joy and eagerness to welcome back repentant sinners.

quiz.q: The person who provided the tomb for the burial of Jesus was _____.
quiz.solution: Joseph of Arimathea, a wealthy member of the Council, asked Pilate for the body and placed it in his own new tomb.

quiz.q: According to Paul in 1 Corinthians 13, the greatest virtue is _____.
quiz.solution: Paul concludes the chapter by stating: 'So now faith, hope, and love abide... but the greatest of these is love'.

quiz.q: The 'Great Commission' involves _____.
quiz.solution: Matthew 28:19 records Jesus' final command to go, baptize, and teach all nations.

quiz.q: Betrayed Jesus:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Judas.

quiz.q: Paul shipwrecked at:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Malta.

quiz.q: Eli's sons:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Hophni and Phinehas.

quiz.q: Esther saved:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Jews.

quiz.q: The turning of water into wine happened at:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Cana of Galilee.

quiz.q: The first miracle of Jesus was:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Turning water into wine.

quiz.q: The fruits of the Spirit are recorded in:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Galatians 5.

quiz.q: Peter denied Jesus:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Three times.

quiz.q: Who helped Jesus carry the cross?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Simon of Cyrene.

quiz.q: The last book of the Bible is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Revelation.

quiz.q: The secret of Samson's strength lay in his...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Hair as a Nazirite.

quiz.q: In Romans, Paul teaches that justification is by...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Faith in Jesus Christ.

quiz.q: Who was the High Priest when Jesus was crucified?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Caiaphas.

quiz.q: Cornelius was a:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Centurion (Gentile).

quiz.q: Philemon was the master of:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Onesimus.

quiz.q: The Triumphal Entry happened on:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Palm Sunday.

quiz.q: Spiritual Gifts are for:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Edification of the Church.

quiz.q: Jonah was sent to:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Nineveh.

quiz.q: Faith without works:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Dead.

quiz.q: Lazarus raised:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Bethany.

quiz.q: Cain killed Abel because?
options: God accepted Abel’s offering and not his
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: God accepted Abel’s offering and not his.

quiz.q: Manna and Quails were provided for the Israelites in the?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Wilderness.

quiz.q: Gideon defeated the Midianites with only?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: 300 men.

quiz.q: Elijah was taken to heaven in a?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Chariot of fire.

quiz.q: Job was tested by God to prove?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: His integrity.

quiz.q: The book of Psalms is primarily for?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Worship and Prayer.

quiz.q: Gomer was a?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Harlot.

quiz.q: John the Baptist's message was?
options: Repent, for the kingdom is at hand
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Repent, for the kingdom is at hand.

quiz.q: The Good Samaritan helped a man?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Beaten by robbers.

quiz.q: The first person to see the risen Jesus was?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Mary Magdalene.

quiz.q: Luke was a?

quiz.q: Peter had a vision of?
options: A sheet with clean and unclean animals
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: A sheet with clean and unclean animals.
